column1: # EACH ENTRY IS PACKED ON ITS OWN (decision 0022 §2.6), at the Integer width
# its `#width` line gives: `int64`, or `target` once its units compute at the
# target's 32 bits. tools/doom/pack-core.rb --entry NAME reads it; an entry not
# yet moved stays int64 whatever the units it shares declare.
# AN ENTRY AT THE TARGET WIDTH IS PACKED FROM ITS OWN UNITS: its `#units` line
# names them. A 32-bit body refuses every top-level constant past 32 bits in its
# file, closure or not, and the units it does not reach carry such tables.
